frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the transformation that took place in the village of Ryemouth between 1995 and the present day.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, Ryemouth has undergone significant development, shifting from a village with a fishing industry and agricultural land to a tourism-oriented destination. Most notably, all fishing-related infrastructure has been removed, while new sports amenities and additional accommodation have been constructed.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the northern and eastern parts of the village, the farmland that previously occupied the northeastern area has been replaced by a golf course, and tennis courts have been constructed immediately to the south of it. Additionally, the forest park that once stood in the central-eastern part of the village has been entirely cleared, making way for these new recreational developments.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Turning to the southern and western areas, the shop located in the southwestern part of the village was converted into a restaurant, while the adjacent fish market was demolished and replaced with a block of apartments. Furthermore, the fishing port, which had previously served as a key feature along the southern coastline, no longer exists in the present layout. In contrast, the hotel situated in the central-eastern area has been retained, though a car park has been added alongside it. The cafe in the southern section also remained unchanged throughout the period. Finally, the housing estate in the northwestern corner saw some expansion, with a new row of houses being constructed on the western side of the main road.
